records.claim: Acyclovir/valacyclovir has been prescribed during pregnancy when a woman has a primary (first time) genital herpes infection. Primary infections can be life-threatening or lead to complications in a pregnancy. A rare but serious lung complication caused by chickenpox virus infection called varicella pneumonia might also require treatment with these medications. MotherToBaby has a fact sheet on varicella infection (chickenpox) here: https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/varicella/.
